seed_scope: Global FMath::RandInit before loading the map and before deferred clone spawning; not a guarantee of identical whole-engine stochastic traces.
active_count_definition: Original NPC class, visible, actor collision enabled, actual AI Blackboard has IsAtHome=false. Actor tick and brain running are reported separately.
world_actor_tick_scope: FPlatformTime span between OnWorldPreActorTick and OnWorldPostActorTick for this PIE world. Includes all actors and intervening world work, not isolated NPC CPU time, a complete game-thread time, or GPU time. Tick starts within the capture window; its completion can cross the final boundary.
frame_interval_scope: Wall-clock intervals between actual game-thread OnEndFrame delegates wholly inside the capture window. Includes editor, PIE, rendering waits, frame caps and instrumentation; not standalone packaged-game FPS or isolated GPU frame time.
memory_scope: Whole editor process physical memory sampled at least 0.25 seconds apart; not per-NPC allocation or an allocation cap. Lifetime OS peak also includes startup and map loading.
